status: root accepts named future adaptation direction; not implemented or executable experiment contract
name: same-owner complete-packet acquire/publish/consume/return while disjoint peer DMA stays active
selected_direction: bounded software ownership/cache glue using existing exact-span DEFAULT and current WT primitives
minimum_contract: 精确描述packet、全部span、源/目的buffer和cookie/capacity；packet3必须503+1011两段齐才是1514B完整包
绑定实际WT配置、single-hart和CPU PA/IOVA alias；源/目的与metadata有明确所有权，禁止其他issuer/rebind或未知访问
启动前把header/源/目的初始化全部写完，排空CPU写buffer并完成本平台cache交接；header与payload共享行内不留未排空CPU写
DMA持有的payload/整cacheline闭包不可由CPU或别的owner访问；CPU仅访问已完成packet的整行闭包及独立metadata。禁止peer-active时全16KiB池/全guard扫描
每个span positive NEXT与expected DONE对应；所有相关span结束，且该packet不再有未完成/未来R/W/B访问。先据已有primitive形成受控lane-drain证明，不能将一个STATUS读冒充通用证明
完整packet交接前执行whole-cache fence.i并确保返回后的payload可见性，然后有序publish used、从原B cookie/address消费；下一包另作交接，不能复用早先在peer未完成时缓存的payload
A源读退休、A/host staging归还、B used发布和B guest实际消费后的归还分别记录；copy全部完成是保守源读退休边界，host free_pkts不是B消费
buffer逻辑归还不撤销覆盖peer的2MiB resident leaf。最终停止所有相关issuer、checked quiet/barrier后才unmap/free；unknown NEXT/timeout/无法证明关闭时保留且quarantine相关共享allocation
明确成功路径核验或异常状态合同及实际成本；DONE不单独升级成无错误包完成
